headline: Barry Callebaut Flavourcode, Planet A cocoa booster, Roquette gluten-free; GLP-1 hits chocolate
summary: Barry Callebaut's Flavourcode launch puts a major competitor ahead in controlled cocoa fermentation flavour; Belcolade should assess the gap and speed up its own fermentation-flavour offer.
Planet A Foods and other cocoa-alternative players are moving into cocoa-powder replacers with fibre and GLP-1 claims, a partnership target or direct competitor for Belcolade cocoa-saving solutions.
Roquette (gluten-free hydrocolloid) and Palsgaard (powdered cake emulsifier) launched products squarely in Puratos's gluten-free and cake-improver territory; benchmark them against Puratos ranges.
GLP-1 drugs and falling US confectionery volumes at Hershey point to smaller, reduced-sugar indulgence, while Fooditive's rare sugar 5-KDF nears FDA review as a sugar-reduction partner.
Ultra-processed food definitions and state additive and dye bans keep building in the US and are now reaching Brussels; keep clean-label, natural-colour reformulation options ready for customers.

items.title: Roquette’s hydrocolloid system takes on gluten-free issues
items.summary: Baking Business covers Roquette's hydrocolloid system aimed at the texture and volume problems of gluten-free bread.
items.why: A large ingredient competitor entering gluten-free bakery texture; benchmark it against Puratos gluten-free mixes and improvers.

items.title: Bacterial community shifts and metabolite-mediated cryoprotection in lactic acid bacteria-fermented sourdoughs: Effects on freezing stability of dough and bread quality
items.summary: Chinese study showing lactic acid bacteria-fermented sourdoughs produce metabolites that protect frozen dough, improving freezing stability and bread quality.
items.why: Relevant to Sapore sourdough and frozen-dough improvers: sourdough as a clean-label cryoprotectant for frozen bakery customers.

items.title: Biolev Plus Wall Yeast Biofermented Solution for Egg Replacement
items.summary: Food Ingredients First features Biolev Plus Wall, a biofermented yeast-cell-wall ingredient marketed for egg replacement.
items.why: Yeast-based egg replacement is directly relevant to Puratos egg-reduction solutions for cakes and sweet goods; evaluate as a competitor or supplier.

items.title: Pepperidge Farm introduces sourdough cookies
items.summary: Pepperidge Farm (Campbell's) has launched sourdough cookies, combining sourdough with bakery-inspired flavours.
items.why: Sourdough moving into sweet biscuits is a product idea for Sapore sourdough in cookies and sweet goods for US industrial customers.

items.title: Microbial Transglutaminase in Bakery Products: Mechanisms, Applications, and Safety
items.summary: Review of microbial transglutaminase in bakery products: mechanisms, applications and safety.
items.why: Transglutaminase is an enzyme lever for gluten-free and high-fibre dough structure; a useful reference for Puratos enzyme and improver R&D.

items.title: What do GLP-1s mean for chocolate?
items.summary: BakeryandSnacks examines what GLP-1 weight-loss drugs mean for chocolate demand.
items.why: GLP-1 users eat smaller, less sugary portions; Belcolade should prepare portion-controlled, reduced-sugar and protein/fibre-enriched chocolate.

items.title: From Oleogel Structure to Product Performance: Rice Wax‐ and Glyceryl Monostearate‐Based Palm Oil Alternatives for Chocolate Spreads
items.summary: Portuguese-Spanish study replacing palm oil in chocolate spreads with rice-wax or glyceryl-monostearate oleogels, keeping texture and improving lubrication.
items.why: Palm-free, lower-saturated-fat oleogels are a lead for Belcolade spreads and fillings and for patisserie fillings.

items.title: Hershey reports confectionery volume decline as salty snacks deliver growth
items.summary: Hershey reports falling confectionery volumes while its salty snacks grow.
items.why: Weak US chocolate volumes at the largest US confectioner signal pricing and demand pressure for Belcolade's industrial customers.

items.title: KSU, Brazilian baking ingredients company form pact
items.summary: Kansas State University has formed a partnership with a Brazilian baking ingredients company.
items.why: A competitor tying up with KSU's grain-science department is worth tracking; consider Puratos's own academic partnerships in US cereal science.

items.title: Fooditive in advanced talks to commercialize low-cal rare sugar 5-KDF
items.summary: Fooditive has scaled its low-calorie rare sugar 5-KDF to 75,000 L, is seeking licensing partners and awaits an FDA decision.
items.why: A new bulk rare sugar in licensing talks is a partnership lead for sugar-reduced fillings, glazes and chocolate once FDA clears it.

items.title: Mondelez set to buy Undercover Snacks
items.summary: Mondelēz is set to buy Undercover Snacks, maker of chocolate-covered quinoa crisps positioned as permissible indulgence.
items.why: Big chocolate makers are buying better-for-you chocolate snacks; a cue for Belcolade inclusions and coatings for wellness snack customers.

items.title: Effect of sun and convective drying under different temperature–time conditions on the physicochemical and bioactive properties of Mexican Forastero cocoa beans (Theobroma cacao L.)
items.summary: Mexican study comparing sun drying with controlled convective drying (35-50 °C) of fermented Forastero cocoa beans, measuring colour, polyphenols and antioxidant capacity.
items.why: Controlled drying cut drying time from 56 to 14 hours while shaping bean colour and polyphenols; useful for Belcolade origin and post-harvest quality programmes.

items.title: Black hollyhock (Alcea rosea var. nigra) flower as a functional additive to enhance the quality characteristics of red velvet cake
items.summary: Iranian study using black hollyhock flower as a natural colourant in red velvet cake instead of synthetic carmoisine, with better antioxidant and oxidative stability.
items.why: With US synthetic-dye pressure, a natural red for red velvet cakes is a lead for Puratos patisserie colour and mix reformulation.

items.title: UNC, Harvard Launch Initiative to Inform Ultra-Processed Food Policymaking
items.summary: UNC and Harvard have launched an initiative to provide evidence for ultra-processed food policymaking.
items.why: Research feeding UPF policy will shape how packaged bread, cakes and chocolate are judged in the US; track its outputs and keep clean-label reformulation ready.

items.title: Structured chocolate-based 3D food printing inks stabilized by camelina seed protein–mucilage complex coacervates
items.summary: Study on chocolate-based 3D-printing inks stabilised by camelina protein-mucilage coacervates.
items.why: 3D-printable chocolate structures are an early lead for Belcolade decorations and personalised patisserie.

items.title: Mondelēz sues British chocolate brand in Toblerone trademark dispute
items.summary: Mondelēz is suing vegan chocolate maker Catherine's Originals, claiming its O'bar infringes Toblerone's shape trademark.
items.why: Shows big brands defending shape trademarks against plant-based chocolate; relevant to Belcolade customers designing vegan bars.

items.title: State food chemical laws don’t create chaos. They make food safer for everyone.
items.summary: EWG argues that state food-chemical laws make food safer rather than creating chaos.
items.why: State additive bans keep spreading; keep a state-by-state view of banned additives and dyes for US bakery, patisserie and chocolate customers.

items.title: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s food fight is coming to Brussels
items.summary: POLITICO reports that RFK Jr.'s food-additive and UPF agenda is spreading to the EU debate in Brussels.
items.why: US-style additive and UPF pressure could reach EU rules, affecting Puratos's European recipes too; monitor and align reformulation across regions.
